skills.label: Written & verbal communication
skills.what: Writing and speaking so that busy people understand, remember, and act: clear, short, structured, and matched to the audience.
skills.reads_as: Positioning, messaging and campaign briefs: the words the market and the sales team repeat.
skills.line: Wrote the positioning and messaging hierarchy for a relaunch across 4 channels; message pull-through in sales decks rose to 80%.

skills.label: Positioning & messaging
skills.what: Deciding how the product is described: to whom, against what alternative, and why it is better, in words customers repeat.
skills.reads_as: The core craft: positioning statements, messaging hierarchies and the words of the brand.
skills.line: Repositioned the brand for a new segment with a messaging hierarchy adopted across 10 campaigns; aided awareness up 12 points.

skills.label: Go-to-market strategy
skills.what: Planning how a product reaches customers: channel, positioning, launch, enablement, and what success looks like commercially.
skills.reads_as: The core: segment, message, channel and launch plan for every product and campaign.
skills.line: Owned go-to-market for 6 launches in 2 years; the biggest delivered $10M of first-year pipeline.

skills.label: Cross-functional leadership
skills.what: Leading a team you don't manage: engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, legal, all pulling toward one outcome.
skills.reads_as: Working with product, sales and agencies so a launch or campaign is one coordinated effort.
skills.line: Led the go-to-market for a product launch across product, sales and 2 agencies; 50 pieces of collateral shipped on one plan.

skills.label: Sales enablement & field partnership
skills.what: Giving sales and customer-facing teams what they need to sell and support the product: training, materials, and a feedback channel back.
skills.line: Ran enablement for 120 AEs on the new platform; 85% certified within a month.

skills.label: Market & competitive analysis
skills.what: Understanding the market you are in: size, trends, competitors, and where the openings are.
skills.reads_as: Market, competitor and customer research behind segmentation and positioning.
skills.line: Led segmentation research with 2,000 respondents; 3 target segments defined and used in the annual plan.

skills.label: Collaboration & teamwork
skills.what: Being good to work with: generous with credit, open to being wrong, and reliable to the people around you.
skills.reads_as: Working with sales, product, agencies and creative so one campaign carries one message.
skills.line: Ran a launch campaign with product, sales and 2 agencies; 12 assets shipped on one calendar and sales adopted all of them.

skills.label: Product launches
skills.what: Getting a product out the door: readiness, staged rollout, enablement, announcement, and the follow-through once real users hit it.
skills.line: Launched the new onboarding to 100% in 3 weeks with no P1 incidents via a staged rollout.

skills.label: Stakeholder management
skills.what: Keeping the people who can block or accelerate your work informed, heard, and on side: executives, partner teams, customers.
skills.reads_as: Aligning sales, product and leadership behind one message and one launch plan.
skills.line: Aligned sales leadership and 3 product teams on the launch messaging in 2 reviews; launch shipped on the planned date.

skills.label: Adaptability & fast-paced environments
skills.what: Working well when the plan changes: ambiguity, pace, pivots, and growth that outruns process.
skills.reads_as: Fast-moving channels and campaigns: learning and switching tactics as results come in.
skills.line: Shifted 40% of paid budget across channels mid-quarter on weekly results; hit the pipeline target at 15% lower CAC.

skills.label: Customer & executive-facing engagement
skills.what: Representing the product to the outside world: customer executives, advisory boards, conferences, analysts, and press.
skills.line: Ran the 20-member customer advisory board for three years.

skills.label: Ownership & bias for action
skills.what: Treating outcomes as yours: driving work to done, taking responsibility when it goes wrong, and not waiting to be told.
skills.reads_as: Owning a campaign or channel budget and the pipeline or revenue it must return.
skills.line: Owned a $2M paid budget and its pipeline target; delivered 115% of pipeline at 20% lower CAC.

skills.label: AI / machine learning
skills.what: Understanding how machine learning products work: data, models, evaluation, and the product decisions that differ from deterministic software.
skills.reads_as: Personalization, targeting and content models that lift campaign performance.
skills.line: Launched ML-driven audience targeting across paid channels; conversion up 15% at the same spend.

skills.label: Execution & delivery
skills.what: Getting things done reliably and well: driving to outcomes, holding quality, and keeping the details from slipping.
skills.reads_as: Launching campaigns on the calendar and delivering the pipeline or revenue they promised.
skills.line: Launched 8 campaigns on schedule in a year and delivered 110% of the pipeline target.

skills.label: Influence without authority
skills.what: Getting people to change course without being able to tell them to: evidence, framing, relationships, and timing.
skills.reads_as: Getting sales, product and leadership to carry one positioning and fund the plan.
skills.line: Secured a 30% budget increase for demand generation with a pipeline model; sales leadership co-sponsored the plan.

skills.label: Enterprise SaaS & B2B
skills.what: Selling software to companies: admin, security, procurement, multi-tenant platforms, and long sales cycles.
skills.line: Shipped the enterprise tier (SSO, SCIM, audit logs); unlocked 12 six-figure deals.

skills.label: Content & social media marketing
skills.what: Planning and producing content (blogs, video, social posts) that draws and engages an audience.
skills.line: Grew the content calendar with creators, agencies; followers or engagement.

skills.label: Growth, funnels & retention
skills.what: Growing usage systematically: acquisition, activation, retention, referral, and the loops that compound.
skills.line: Owned activation; day-7 retention rose from 31% to 44% via onboarding redesign.

skills.label: Customer obsession / user empathy
skills.what: Making decisions from the customer's point of view, backed by direct contact with them, rather than from internal convenience.
skills.line: Ran 80 customer interviews in a year; three roadmap items came directly from them.

skills.label: Marketing campaigns
skills.what: Planning, launching and optimizing marketing campaigns across channels.
skills.line: Ran the integrated campaign with agencies, creative; budget.

skills.label: Program & project management
skills.what: Coordinating large, multi-team efforts: plans, milestones, dependencies, status, and getting the whole thing to land.
skills.reads_as: Running campaigns and launches on a calendar with agencies, creative and sales.
skills.line: Ran the launch program across 6 workstreams and 2 agencies; 40 deliverables shipped on the launch date.

skills.label: Metrics & KPIs
skills.what: Choosing the few numbers that tell you whether the product is working, instrumenting them, and watching them with discipline.
skills.reads_as: Funnel and campaign metrics: reach, conversion, pipeline and ROI by channel.
skills.line: Built the funnel dashboard from impression to closed-won for 8 channels; used in every weekly marketing review.

skills.label: Structured problem solving
skills.what: Breaking an ambiguous situation into parts, finding the real cause, and choosing an approach when the answer isn't obvious.
skills.reads_as: Diagnosing why a funnel, campaign or message underperforms and what to change.
skills.line: Diagnosed a 20% drop in paid conversion to a landing-page change within 2 days and recovered it the same week.

skills.label: AI tooling in daily work
skills.what: Using AI tools in daily product work: prototyping, analysis, writing, and research, faster than before.
skills.line: Prototyped 6 feature concepts with AI tools in Q1; 2 shipped after user tests.

skills.label: Data-driven decision making
skills.what: Using data to make and defend decisions: pulling it, questioning it, and knowing when it is wrong or insufficient.
skills.reads_as: Measuring every channel and campaign and moving the budget on the results.
skills.line: Built the attribution model for 6 channels and reallocated 25% of a $4M budget; CAC fell 18%.

skills.label: Technical fluency
skills.what: Understanding how software is built well enough to make good trade-offs with engineers, without needing to write the code yourself.
skills.line: Led the build-vs-buy decision for the search service with engineering.

skills.label: Product strategy
skills.what: Choosing where to play and how to win: which customers, which problems, which bets, and what you will deliberately not do.
skills.line: Authored the 2025 platform strategy adopted by three product teams.

skills.label: Roadmapping
skills.what: Turning strategy into a sequenced, time-boxed plan of what the team will build, and keeping it honest as reality changes.
skills.line: Owned the H2 roadmap for checkout; shipped 4 of 5 committed initiatives.

skills.label: Personas & segmentation
skills.what: Describing who you are building for in a way that is specific enough to change decisions: segments, personas, and the jobs they hire the product for.
skills.line: Redefined the ICP to mid-market ops teams; win rate in that segment rose 30%.

skills.label: Generative AI / LLMs & agents
skills.what: Building products on large language models and agents: prompting, retrieval, evaluation, cost, safety, and the new UX patterns they need.
skills.line: Shipped the AI assistant to 50k users; built the eval harness that gates every prompt change.

skills.label: Customer stories & advocacy
skills.what: Turning customer wins into case studies, references and advocacy that help sell.
skills.line: Published the case study with customers, sales; case studies published.

skills.label: Product sense & judgment
skills.what: Judgment about what makes a product good: spotting the right problem, the elegant solution, and the detail that will annoy users.
skills.line: Redesigned the checkout flow from 6 steps to 3; conversion up 18%.

skills.label: Process design & operational rigor
skills.what: Designing how work gets done so it scales: operating cadence, mechanisms, playbooks, and removing waste.
skills.reads_as: Building the playbooks and marketing-ops processes that make campaigns repeatable.
skills.line: Built the campaign launch playbook and automation templates; time to launch a campaign fell from 4 weeks to 10 days.

skills.label: Prioritization & trade-offs
skills.what: Deciding what to do first, what to defer, and what to kill, with a rationale others can check, under constraints you don't control.
skills.reads_as: Choosing channels, campaigns and segments for a fixed budget.
skills.line: Prioritized 3 of 8 proposed campaigns for a $2M budget on expected pipeline; delivered 120% of target.

skills.label: Executive communication & reviews
skills.what: Communicating with executives and boards: the brief, the business review, and the ask, in the little time they have.
skills.reads_as: Marketing reviews with leadership: results, the plan and the budget ask.
skills.line: Presented the quarterly marketing review to the executive team 8 times; secured a 25% budget increase on the results.

skills.label: Partnerships & ecosystem
skills.what: Building and managing relationships with other companies: integrations, platforms, resellers, and the ecosystem around the product.
skills.reads_as: Co-marketing and agency partnerships that extend reach.
skills.line: Ran co-marketing with 8 partners in a year; partner campaigns delivered 30% of event pipeline.

skills.label: Cloud platforms
skills.what: Working knowledge of cloud platforms: core services, cost, and how infrastructure choices shape the product.
skills.line: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; owned the migration PRD to managed Kubernetes.

skills.label: Pricing & packaging
skills.what: Deciding what to charge, how to bundle features into tiers, and how the model shapes who buys and how they use the product.
skills.line: Led the move from per-seat to usage-based pricing; net revenue retention rose to 118%.
